notes.title: The icing on the cake
notes.content:
Only a week since the previous update, and here is another one already! This one is mostly cosmetic, adding some polish to existing features.

Changelist:
- Added game title to window
- Improved windows icons
- Always drawing black bars in letterboxed mode, solving graphics problems caused by Steam overlay
- Added text "waiting for more players" to multiplayer select screen
- Replaced tiny font in menus with a slightly larger one
- Scaling light beams when jumping a ramp
- Larger Senile Team logo during startup
- Display message if no friends' records returned by Steam server

notes.title: Window handling & other improvements
notes.content:
Hello gamers,

Rush Rush Rally Reloaded has just received a small update. The following things have changed:

[list]
[*] [b]Updated graphics renderer.[/b] This allows the game to use an optimised resolution, which is then scaled to match your computer's resolution. This fixes some graphics glitches that used to happen on some systems.
[*] [b]Improved window handling.[/b] Because the entire screen can now be dynamically rescaled, this also allows for window resizing. Press F11 or Alt+Enter to switch between full-screen mode and a window.
[*] [b]Borderless window.[/b] The full-screen mode is now rendered in a borderless window. That means easier switching between different windows, as well as a potentially higher frame rate (depending on your system).
[*] [b]Steam API update.[/b] The game was updated with the latest version of the Steam API.
[*] [b]More games menu item.[/b] You can now browser other games by Senile Team in the game's main menu.
[*] [b]Stability fixes.[/b] Various behind-the-scenes fixes that should fix potential bugs before they even happened.
[/list]

Have fun playing!
